To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

device aging and thermal side channel are two emerging (un-)reliable based security threats that can be used to launch hardware attacks on embedded systems and can be mitigated by utilizing thermal side channels and machine learning.
device aging can be used for transient attacks, thermal side channels can be utilized to monitor code execution on embedded devices, and machine learning is an effective tool for detecting anomalies.

(1) aging effects can be used as attack vector to cause transient degradation in the embedded processor without any trace of the malicious activity, and (2) thermal side channels can be utilized to detect anomaly (e.g. code injection or modification).
